name: Velocity
description: Animated vector-field layer (wind/current streamlines or particles) rendered on the 2D map from gridded velocity data.

supportedData.label: Gridded velocity field (u/v components)
supportedData.description: A gridded vector field describing u/v components, in the leaflet-velocity JSON layout (typically GRIB2 converted to JSON). Rendered as animated streamlines.
supportedData.procurement: Convert GRIB2 to the velocity-JSON layout (e.g. grib2json).

supportedData.label: Point vectors for particle animation
supportedData.description: GeoJSON point features used to seed the 'particles' (rain) animation kind.
